documents: Copy of the inventory or packing list
Original or express-release bill of lading
Signed letter letting your mover clear and collect the shipment
Signed letter asking the shipping line to release the delivery order
dutyFree: Used household goods and personal belongings enter without duty
restricted: Banned: weapons, real or decorative firearms, swords, ammunition and fireworks
Banned: alcohol, narcotics and large amounts of medicine, even with a prescription
Banned: radio transmitters, adult material, gambling items and some religious or political books
Books, films, photos and other media are checked by authorities first
Drones need a civil aviation licence; plants, seeds and fresh fruit may be destroyed
notes: New items pay 5% duty on their value, plus 5% VAT and fees
A UAE residence visa is required before customs will clear your goods
Most shipments are X-rayed or opened, with extra handling fees
Pack books, CDs and DVDs in their own clearly marked boxes
Keep receipts for new items, or customs will set the value and may charge a USD 300 fee

restricted: Drones cannot be shipped with personal belongings
